 introduction 
Are you looking for a varied job as a reach truck driver during the day (07:00-16:00 or 08:00-17:00)? Come work at DSV in Tholen! You can work 4 or 5 days a week and earn a gross hourly wage of between €15.71 and €16.03. You also get free fresh fruit every day and have the prospect of a permanent contract. 
Don't have WhatsApp? We will contact you by phone or email instead! 
 what we offer 
 Up to € 16.03 per hour, depending on experience 
 Travel expense allowance € 0.25 per km 
 Working from Monday till Friday on the day shift 
 A job with many career opportunities 
 Working with nice colleague's 
 Possibility to get a contract with the company 
 who you are 
To qualify as a reach truck driver, it is important that you meet the following requirements: - You are 18 years or older - You speak English - You are willing to work in Tholen - You are available for 32 or 40 hours a week - You are available for day shifts - You have your own car - You hold a valid reach truck certificate 
 what will you do 
In this role as a reach truck driver, you are indispensable! You ensure that trucks are unloaded quickly and efficiently and place the pallets in the correct location in the warehouse. Additionally, you are responsible for loading the trucks and ensuring that everything is put back in the right place. Is it quiet for a moment? Then you lend a hand to your colleagues with order picking and packing. Furthermore, you regularly work in a cool environment (4-6 degrees), for which you will receive special clothing. Your main tasks are: - Replenish warehouse shelves - Occasionally lift and move products manually - Carefully load and unload trucks

Looking for a stable full-time job with a good salary and great benefits?

Then this could be the job for you!

We are looking for motivated Warehouse Workers to join the DHL Supply Chain team in Weert. No long experience needed – you will receive training on the job and have plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Full-time availability – You are available to work 40 hours per week, shifts from 06:00 - 15:00 & 15:00 - 00:00, rotating weekly.

Own transportation – You can travel to and from the workplace independently.

English skills – You can communicate in English at work.

Reliable and motivated – You are dependable, willing to work hard and enjoy working in team.

Would you like to work for one of the largest logistics service providers worldwide? At DHL in Holtum, you will be part of a dynamic and international work environment where every day is different. No experience in logistics? No problem, we will teach you everything you need to know. Already have experience? Great! We willl help you grow and develop your skills even further. What do we expect from you? You speak Dutch and/or English You are available for dayshift or 2-shift work, with shifting hours between 08:00–17:00 You are able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) What do we offer? A starting salary of €15,12 per hour, with the opportunity for a salary increase after a few months 30% shift allowance for all hours worked after 6:00 PM Travel allowance up to €9.30 per day 25 paid vacation days per year plus 8.33% holiday pay The chance to get your EPT, OPT, forklift, and reach truck certifications Full training provided, no prior experience required Plenty of opportunities to grow your career in logistics Work in a dynamic and international team at one of the world’s largest logistics companies As a logistics employee, you will be working in the warehouse of DHL Supply Chain in Born. In this all-round logistics role, your main tasks include: Labeling and stickering packages Carefully packing products Preparing goods for transport Keeping the work environment clean and safe working with computers

Looking for a job where you stay active and earn a great salary? At GXO in Heerlen, you’ll work in a modern warehouse for well-known brands like Zara, H&M, Primark, IKEA, and Ahold. You make sure every order is ready on time.

As a warehouse worker, you keep everything running smoothly:

- Picking orders like clothing and shoes
- Packing items carefully and preparing them for shipment
- Helping to keep stock organized

You’ll work full-time in a 2-shift system (morning and afternoon). The schedule is clear and planned in advance, so you always know what to expect.

- You can speak and read English
- You have your own transport to GXO Heerlen
- You’re available fulltime in 2 shifts
- Experience in logistics is nice, but not required (GXO teach you everything)

Are you a true go-getter with leadership experience in logistics? Do you know how to motivate a team and ensure that everything runs smoothly on the shop floor? Then we’re looking for you!

As a Warehouse Team Leader, you’ll be the first point of contact for your team. You’ll actively participate on the shop floor, manage your colleagues, and ensure that daily logistics processes are carried out safely, efficiently, and according to schedule.

What will you do?
As a Warehouse Team Leader, you will lead a team of approximately 5 to 15 warehouse employees and temporary workers. Together, you make sure all warehouse activities are completed safely, efficiently, and on time.

Your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating daily inbound, storage, order picking, and outbound activities.
- Leading, coaching, and supporting warehouse employees on the work floor.
- Monitoring productivity, quality, and safety standards.
- Ensuring accurate administrative processing in the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
- Reporting operational issues and supporting continuous process improvements.
- Working closely with the Warehouse Supervisor and Customer Service to achieve daily operational targets.
- Helping to create a safe, clean, and organized working environment.

You are a hands-on leader who enjoys working in a fast-paced warehouse environment and knows how to motivate a team.

You also have:

- An MBO Level 3 qualification, preferably in Logistics.
- At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory role within logistics or manufacturing.
- Experience working in a warehouse environment.
- Good communication skills in English (Dutch is an advantage).
- A proactive attitude and strong organizational skills.
- A focus on safety, quality, and teamwork.
- A valid Certificate of Conduct (VOG). If your VOG is approved, Olympia will reimburse the cost of €41.35. If your VOG is not approved, the cost will be at your own expense.
- You have your own accommodation;

About the job

Are you precise, motivated, and do you enjoy working in a clean and well-organized environment? As a Cleanroom Operator, you will make sure that components are carefully cleaned, inspected, and packaged for customers in the high-tech industry.This is a varied position where accuracy, quality, and teamwork are key.

What will you do?

In this role, you will work in a cleanroom environment where precision and quality are essential. You will work with customers from the high-tech, medical, automotive, and aerospace industries — sectors where there is no room for error and where your work directly contributes to the final product.As a Cleanroom Operator, you will play an important role in cleaning, inspecting, and packaging components. You will work according to clear protocols and detailed work instructions.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning components using modern machines or manually
- (Dis)assembling components based on technical drawings
- Performing detailed quality inspections, including inspections using UV lamps
Packaging components in the cleanroom to ensure they arrive at the customer in perfect condition

You will work in a modern, safe, and well-organized environment where teamwork and quality are highly valued.

What are we looking for?

- MBO-level education or equivalent working and thinking level
- Experience in a cleanroom or assembly environment is a plus, but not required — we are happy to train you
- Good command of English; Dutch is a plus
- You work accurately and independently and have a flexible attitude
- You are available to work in shifts: 06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00
- You don't meet all the requirements but think this position could be a good fit for you? We would still love to hear from you!

Are you an experienced logistics employee with valid certificates and looking for a new challenge? For one of our clients, we are looking for motivated logistics staff who can work both independently and as part of a team.

Key Responsibilities

- Load, unload and move goods within the Service Centre using a forklift, reach truck, stacker or other transport equipment.
- Receive, store and process incoming goods, including the related administrative tasks.
- Manage internal product movements and maintain accurate inventory levels.
- Ensure product quality while following all safety, environmental and housekeeping procedures.

The job runs in a 2-shift rotation: one week from Monday to Friday, 06:00–15:00, followed by a week from Monday to Friday, 15:00–00:00.

- Proven experience in logistics (required)
- Valid certificate for:
- EPT (Electric Pallet Truck)
- Forklift
- Stacker
- Minimum English level A2 (spoken and written)
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift system
- Accurate, motivated, and reliable
- Able to work both independently and as part of a team

Are you looking for an active warehouse job that fits perfectly with your personal life? Then this is your chance! We are currently looking for motivated order pickers and packers who can start immediately and are available for both morning and afternoon shifts. Using modern tools such as hand scanners and voice picking, you will collect orders quickly and accurately. You make sure every order is complete and ready for shipment.

In this role, you will stay active throughout the day and play an important part in keeping the logistics process running smoothly.

Working hours (2 shift system):

- Morning: 07:00 – 16:00
- Afternoon: 16:00 – 00:00

- You speak English or Dutch
- You are available at least 2 days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2 shift system
- You are physically able to perform active work (standing, walking, lifting)
- No experience is required, motivation are most important
- Resident of the Netherlands
- Valid work permit for the Netherlands required
- No housing available

Looking for a flexible job where you can stay active?

Join Dragonfly in Waddinxveen and decide for yourself which days you want to work. Perfect as a part-time job alongside your studies or another job. Together with your colleagues, you’ll make sure that packages are processed quickly and carefully, so drivers can hit the road on time.

What will you do?

- Place packages on the conveyor belt.
- Sort shipments into the correct roll containers or delivery vans.
- Check that drivers leave with the correct packages.
- Work together with your team to ensure the logistics process runs smoothly.

Working hours

- Morning shifts starting between 4:00 AM and 7:00 AM.
- Your workday ends around 12:00 PM.
- You can work from Monday to Sunday.
- You decide which days you are available.

What do we offer?

- An attractive hourly wage of €14.99 per hour, depending on your working hours and any applicable allowances.
- Working between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM? You will receive a night shift allowance, and your hourly wage can increase to €19.49 gross per hour.

What do we expect from you?

- You are available for morning shifts that start between 4:00 AM and 7:00 AM and finish around 12:00 PM. The exact start time may vary depending on the shift.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- You speak Dutch and/or English.
- You work accurately, are motivated, and are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get to work.
- You live in or near Waddinxveen, Gouda, Zoetermeer, Bleiswijk, or The Hague.
- You have your own means of transportation, as our location has limited access by public transport.

The role of a Multi-skilled Bartender contributes to a lively bar experience where crafted drinks, warm hospitality and modern style come together effortlessly.
Park Plaza Eindhoven offers 104 stylish rooms and suites in the heart of the City of Light, within walking distance of Central Station, Van Abbemuseum and Strijp S. Guests enjoy a large heated indoor pool, two saunas, a fitness area and vibrant social spaces.
As a Multi Skilled Bartender, you run the bar independently during the 15:00-23:00 shift. You craft drinks, prepare simple heated or frozen dishes, support restaurant service and assist banqueting setups. You move confidently between bar, restaurant and event service, ensuring a smooth guest experience throughout the evening.
Responsibilities

• Craft drinks to specification while delivering warm, confident service.
• Maintain a clean, organised bar and ensure product quality.
• Prepare simple heated or frozen food items.
• Support restaurant service and assist banqueting setups and service.
• Work independently during the 15:00-23:00 shift.
• Follow hygiene, labelling and safety protocols.

Essential Requirements

• Experience in bar service or a similar guest facing role.
• Able to work independently across bar, restaurant and banqueting.
• Comfortable with light cooking tasks
• Eligible to work in the Netherlands and fluent in English.
• Preferred Requirements
• Cocktail knowledge and interest in service trends.
• Familiarity with POS systems (training provided).

Your Benefits & Perks

• Discounted hotel rates, including Radisson Hotel Group worldwide and family & friends
• 50% Food & Beverage discount at our restaurants and bars
• Exclusive employee benefit store discounts
• Discount on the collective health insurance from VGZ
• Great (online) Learning & Development opportunities
• Advanced onboarding programme
• Career opportunities across PPHE Europe
• Tasty meal during your shift
• Annual staff parties and outings
• Birthday bonus (€250 gross)

Start working as a Logistics Employee in Eindhoven and earn a gross hourly wage of €19.26. You will also have the opportunity to get a direct contract based on good performance. Are you ready for the next step in your career? Apply today!

Your tasks include:

    - Receiving, checking and processing incoming goods and related documents
    
- Picking orders and delivering materials to the production departments on time
    
- Carrying out first-line quality checks and visual inspections
    
- Performing packing and unpacking activities
    
- Replenishing missing items based on pick lists
    
- Operating a reach truck and, when required, other internal transport equipment
    
- Processing and preparing outgoing goods, parts and service shipments for dispatch

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €19.26 per hour
    
- Shift allowance when working in a two-shift schedule (20%)
    
- Travel allowance according to the client's reimbursement policy
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower with the possibility of a permanent contract based on good performance
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Varied logistics position in an international working environment
    
- Opportunities to obtain certificates and further develop your skills

    - At least one year of experience in a logistics position

- Good command of the English language both spoken and written, because you will be communicating in this language mainly

Does this Logistics Employee position in Eindhoven sound like the right fit for you? Don't wait too long and apply today! After receiving your application, a Manpower recruiter will contact you as soon as possible.

If you have a technical mindset (or are eager to learn!), you’ll fit right in!

Your daily responsibilities as a production worker include:

3-shift system (06:00–14:15 and 14:00–22:15 and 22.00 - 6.15
